messages:
Maria: Follow-up from the morning outage - we need concrete evals and owners so fixes stick.
Tom: brief list please and I'll pick up load/replay.
Maria: Quick plan: 1) compact regression prompt set for the fallback path, 2) a replay load scenario that duplicates the short burst + mid-sequence long generations, 3) a KV-cache eviction drill in staging, 4) CI light eval (warn-first).
Linda: Paste the prompts so I can make low-noise tests.
Maria: Scrubbed samples below (will add a few more in the PR):
```
"Condense ticket and list next actions with owners."
"From history, write a 3-line follow-up that confirms next steps."
"Re-rank results for intent Z and give a one-line reason."
```
Tom: I'll craft a k6 scenario: 200 concurrent for 45s bursts, each session has 2 short gens and 1 long gen mid-session. I'll add a replay/runbook.
Kevin: For eviction chaos: I'll create a job that forces aggressive TTLs and rotate caches while measuring p50/p95/p99 and error spikes. Add alert if p99 >25% baseline.
Maria: Owners and short deadlines: Linda -> regression harness + CI job (non-blocking) in 4 business days; Tom -> load replay and runbook in 6 days; Kevin -> chaos drill + dashboard panel in 10 days; Maria -> update release checklist with gating notes in 2 days.
Linda: I'll open a PR under eng-ml/evals/regressions/incident-1769500000 and tag evals:nonblocking. Tests will be conservative to avoid flakiness.
Tom: I'll include a dockerized invoker and exact k6 command for anyone to run locally.
Kevin: I'll export a scrubbed long-history trace to include in the regression set to exercise KV.
Cara: UX note: tighten prompt #2 to reduce variability (explicit lengths and bullets). I'll comment on the PR.
Maria: CI gating flow: start warn-only; after two clean runs in staging with no threshold breaches flip to blocking. Agreed?
Linda: Agreed. I'll post results to the evals dashboard and this thread.
Ops Bot: Reminder: create tracking tickets and apply label incident-1769500000.
Maria: Created JIRA INC-3299 and EVAL-912; PRs: https://git.redwood.co/r/1480 (regression), https://git.redwood.co/r/1481 (k6). Will paste CI shards when available.
Kevin: I'll share dashboard link once panel is up.
Tom: Ping me if infra toggles needed for replay.
Linda: PR opened and linked to EVAL-912, CI started.
Maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene next Tuesday in #eng-ml with initial runs and decide whether to flip gating.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Linda: On it :rocket:
